# Event Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EventType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The kind of an event — a VALUE, never a [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) subclass. The set is open; a kind not among the seed individuals is a FRESH [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label), not a new class. Pointed at by [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) (non-functional).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
